{{Short description|Title held by eminent maths professors at Gresham College}}
[[File:Goriely-blackboard-bw-square.jpg|alt=Alain Goriely|thumb|318x318px|[[Alain Goriely]] FRS, appointed Gresham Professor of Geometry in 2024]]
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
The '''Professor of Geometry''' at '''[[Gresham College]]''', London, gives free educational lectures to the general public. The college was founded for this purpose in 1597, when it created seven professorships; this was later increased to ten. Geometry is one of the original professorships as set out by the will of [[Thomas Gresham]] in 1575. The Professor of Geometry is appointed in partnership with the [[City of London Corporation]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=How We Recruit Speakers {{!}} Gresham College |url=https://www.gresham.ac.uk/about-us/organisation/how-we-recruit-speakers |access-date=2024-06-12 |website=www.gresham.ac.uk |language=en}}</ref>
